sources.title: ProCreations (SSH) - Hugging Face
sources.snippet: This is the first 40B fine tune that reaches "closed source" (IE OpenAI, Claude) level of intelligence in both 8 bit and 4 bit. This model is composed from multiple Qwen 27B Fable Fusion 711 cores (1700+ likes, 2.3 million+ downloads) - a record breaking model in terms of intelligence and raw power.
